newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Telecom signs agreement with Mozambique.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Telecom signs agreement with Mozambique.

text.p: State-owned Mauritius Telecom and Telecomunicacoes De Mocambique have signed an agreement for a joint venture to provide business systems, an official said on Monday.
"The joint venture will serve as a platform for the meaningful cooperation in the development of the regional telecommunications market," the MT official told Reuters.
The memorandum of understanding between the two also provides for them to collaborate in information technology, technical operations and training of personnel.
